operation.title: bayesian_scm_state / commercial coverage
operation.action: A search hit is not a capability or absence finding; matched technical sources and licensing/runtime remain to be checked. Separate posterior computation from causal identification; inspect state observability, priors, approximation error and intervention semantics; banking example: hidden credit state.
criteria: Every candidate and alias is identified, searched with a recorded cutoff and bounded stopping rule.
Technical claims have authentic local bytes, hash, version/date, inspected anchors and supported claims; scholarly originals are real correctly named PDFs.
Alternatives and omissions are explicit; no unsupported absence claim or essential unavailable-source waiver.
operation.owner_role: Current author/coordinator; external evidence retains its authentic named owner
operation.failure_action: Preserve findings and exact evidence. Record a scoped negative/inconclusive outcome or a blocker with acquisition/research trigger. Continue the next ready lane; no automatic phase stop.

rule: Perform, review and record; continue another eligible task after every outcome or local blocker.
